note: [L] proves each estimate for arbitrary exponents `w`, `q`, `a`, profiles `f` and `δ`, with the sign, pressing and conservation hypotheses as `Own`, `Mixed`, `Pressed`, `Conserved`; [M]'s display is the instance with widths `1+c_j`, `q = -3000`, `c_d` and `a=-99`, applied in `exterior_size`.

theorem line_cost (H : S.Hierarchy) (l : Axis) (e : Axis→Bool) (A : Weight L) (hf : ∀ i, Own A i (e i))
    (he : Mixed (other l) e) (h : ∃ i∈other l,e i≠e l) (hp : ∀ j∈other l,Pressed j A)
    (i : Axis) (w : Axis→ℝ) (hw : ∀ j,w j≤0) (δ q : ℝ) (hq : q<0) (hd : 0<δ) (f : Grouping)
    (hl : Colors Finset.univ f) :
    Budget (if i=l then δ else -w l+δ) (fun n => ∫ p,cost i Finset.univ (fuel q n) (mails w f n) p ∂ν (V i) A) := by

proof_context.conclusion: For `B` with mixed signs on the axes other than `l`, any widths `w <= 0`, `q<0` and `δ>0`, `∫ cost i univ (fuel q n) (mails w f n) ∂ν (V i) B` is `Budget δ` if `i=l` and `Budget (-w l + δ)` otherwise; with widths `1+c_j`, `q=-3000` and `δ=1` this is `λ^{κ_d}`.

theorem point_cost (H : S.Hierarchy) (i : Axis) (A : Weight L) (e) (Q : Finset Axis)
    (hi : i∈Q) (he : Mixed Q e) (hp : ∀ i∈Q,Pressed i A) (hk : ∀ i∈Q,Own A i (e i))
    (w : Axis→ℝ) (hw : ∀ i∈Q,w i≤0) (q : ℝ) (hq : q<0) (f : Grouping) (hf : Colors Q f)
    (δ : ℝ) (hd : 0<δ) : Budget δ (fun n => ∫ p,cost i Q (fuel q n) (mails w f n) p ∂ν (V i) A) := by

proof_context.conclusion: The same integral for the point word with both signs is `Budget δ` for every `δ>0` (the second line, for `q = c_d`).

lemma mass (V : ∀ i, Chamber S i) (H : S.Hierarchy) (J : Stress S) (P : DiffPlan S) (hp : P.Derivatives S) (ho : P.Orientation H.spin)
    (hr : RawTensor H.spin J) (C : Conserved P H.spin J) (i : Axis) (A : Weight L) (hA : equalRead S A (pick (J i i)))
    (ha : Own A i false) (hx : Pressed i A) (w : Axis→ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ht : a≤0) (hw : ∀ j,j≠i → w j≤a)
    (f : Grouping) (hf : Colors Finset.univ f) (δ : ℝ) (hd : 0<δ) :
    (∀ n, Integrable (coneWeight i (fuel a n) (mails w f n)) (ν (V i) A)) ∧
    Budget (δ+a*4) (fun n => ∫ p, coneWeight i (fuel a n) (mails w f n) p ∂ν (V i) A) := by

proof_context.conclusion: For the conserved stress `J` and `a<=0` with widths `1+w_j <= a` off `i`, `∫ coneWeight i (fuel a n) (mails w f n) ∂ν (V i) A` is `Budget (δ+4a)`; `coneWeight` is `p_i W^4/(p_i+W)^4` times the transverse profiles, so `a=-99` gives `λ^δ W^4`.
